proof: Real friend.request and friend.accept preserve actor_id and public recipient/actor roles, including HTML escaping
Unsent legacy preview uses unique audit linkage; ambiguous actor produces complete neutral text without a person block
An unclaimed profile/private full_name never becomes a greeting; username fallback is public
All personal templates use absolute PNG and public source identities
Real PostgreSQL division-by-zero during push enqueue does not roll back the friend relation, mail source, outbox or receipt; parallel recovery creates one inbox and one marker
Explicit FID target encrypted under version two authenticated binding; legacy version-one token decrypts
Current-device test enforces account/environment/package/installation binding, request replay, preferences and bounded rate
HTTP-v1 provider mock uses message.fid; ordinary404/invalid-payload400 keep device enabled, structured UNREGISTERED disables it
Provider acceptance, authenticated client receipt, and opening are separate; premature ACK is ignored
Native dispatcher remains bounded to three parallel requests and retained/account-deletion behavior is covered
A deletion-requested recipient immediately fails the same source eligibility check and a new event has no deliverable email address
limits: No FCM device receipt, cold/background Android delivery, Play installation or production sender authorization is proven
Firebase Management403 and missing runtime provider configuration remain external blockers
Existing accepted mail is not changed or resent
Current PNG URL is healthy; historical broken-image cause was not established
legacyFixtures: Only test data changed: canonical whitespace-free immutable handles are separate from the original display labels; the PIN Unicode test claims a fresh real profile per canonical variant instead of renaming an existing handle. No production guard was weakened.
